publicUpdate: I’ll refine the Earth focus view with cool camera-side fill lighting, a more flattering close-up angle, and the Sun kept out of frame while preserving all existing controls, orbits, and startup state.

scene.brief: Full-window Three.js solar system with a starfield background, orbital paths, and planet bodies. Existing HUD controls stay at the screen edges. Selecting Earth focus eases the camera to a slightly elevated close-up, with Earth filling roughly two-thirds of the viewport height. Soft cool blue-white fill from the camera side lights the visible hemisphere so blue oceans and green continents read clearly, while the Sun remains outside the frame. Leaving Earth focus restores the previous lighting and camera smoothly.
visualReview: Add soft cool fill lighting from the camera side during Earth focus so blue oceans and green continents are clearly visible.
